maddeler.e:
نغن (form I)
# نَغَنُّ (naḡannu) /na.ɣan.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of غَنَّ (ḡanna)
# نَغَنَّ (naḡanna) /na.ɣan.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of غَنَّ (ḡanna)
# نَغَنِّ (naḡanni) /na.ɣan.ni/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of غَنَّ (ḡanna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
